name: Cabozantinib (single agent)

biomarkers.note: Clear cell RCC (subtypes #55/#56). Cabozantinib is an oral multikinase inhibitor targeting VEGFR, MET, and AXL; no companion biomarker is required. In the landmark METEOR trial it improved OS, PFS, and ORR versus everolimus after prior VEGF-targeted therapy; also a listed first-line option. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Kidney Cancer v1.2027.

lineOfTherapy: subsequent-line (after prior anti-angiogenic / IO-containing therapy) for advanced clear cell RCC; also a first-line option (single agent)

eligibilityCriteria.locator: v1.2027, systemic therapy for clear cell RCC (Cabozantinib listed; category 2A preferred for poor/intermediate-risk, category 2B other recommended for favorable-risk)

drugs.name: Cabozantinib

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 151812 (cabozantinib at starting dose of 60 mg daily, METEOR trial)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 151812 (METEOR): cabozantinib starting dose 60 mg PO once daily continuously (represented as days 1 to 28 of a nominal 28-day cycle). This is the single-agent cabozantinib dose. NOTE: the cabozantinib dose used in the nivolumab + cabozantinib combination (CheckMate-9ER, protocol gu-rcc-nivo-cabozantinib) is different (40 mg) and is NOT this dose. Common grade 3/4 toxicities: hypertension, diarrhea, fatigue, hand-foot skin reaction.

supportiveCare: Blood pressure monitoring and management (VEGF TKI hypertension).
Monitor for diarrhea, hand-foot skin reaction, and fatigue.
Baseline and periodic thyroid function (TSH) and liver function.

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 hypertension, HFSR, diarrhea, or hepatotoxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Hold and resume at a reduced dose per labeling for grade 3 or higher hypertension, hand-foot skin reaction, diarrhea, or hepatotoxicity; obtain clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 151812-151813 (METEOR: cabozantinib 60 mg daily vs everolimus 10 mg daily)

guideline.locator: Systemic therapy for clear cell RCC (Cabozantinib: category 2A preferred for poor/intermediate-risk, category 2B other recommended for favorable-risk; footnote e, line ~1064). mg dosing not printed in the guideline.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single-agent cabozantinib in advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma (serves clear cell subtypes #55 and #56). The dose (cabozantinib 60 mg PO once daily) is sourced to DeVita 12th ed., line 151812 (the METEOR trial starting dose). This is the MONOTHERAPY dose; the cabozantinib dose in the nivolumab + cabozantinib combination (CheckMate-9ER) is different (40 mg) and is handled separately. Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Kidney Cancer v1.2027 lists cabozantinib as a preferred/other-recommended clear cell RCC regimen but does not print a mg dose. VEGF/MET TKI class monitoring (blood pressure, liver, thyroid, hand-foot skin reaction, proteinuria) is included. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
